entries.title: Women's billion-dollar boom leaves players behind, says Fifpro

entries.title: U.S. restrictions on Chinese drones are hurting cash-strapped police departments

entries.title: Here's what to know if you're unsure about your measles immunity status

entries.snippet: A suspected plot to attack a U.S.-run military air base in England was "almost certainly" directed by Iran's Revolutionary Guard, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Monday.

entries.title: UK: Iran 'highly likely' to be behind RAF Fairford incident
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Andy Burnham told parliament there were "strong indications" of Iranian involvement. The government summoned Iran's ambassador. The scare at RAF Fairford led to the withdrawal of USAF B-1 heavy bombers.

entries.title: Hundreds of French supermarkets hit by a cyberattack that defrosted refrigeration systems
entries.snippet: Hundreds of French supermarkets saw their refrigeration systems defrosted, spoiling tons of frozen food. The unprecedented attack has raised serious questions about food security across Europe.

entries.title: Poland reports arrests of 2 Turkish citizens in Germany in connection with Starlink station fire last month
entries.snippet: Polish authorities have reported the arrests of two Turkish citizens in Germany in connection with alleged sabotage of a Starlink station last month. Prime Minister Donald Tusk called the fire an act of "hybrid warfare."

entries.title: Fact check: Viral videos falsely linked to Riyadh airport attacks
entries.snippet: Many videos claiming to show an attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport have gone viral online. DW Fact check analyzes some of the most-shared footage and finds evidence it was created using AI.

entries.title: Germany: Labor Minister's resignation puts a spotlight on cracks within the government
entries.snippet: Following the sudden resignation of Bärbel Bas as Labor Minister and co-chair of the Social Democratic Party, accusations are flying in Chancellor Merz's coalition government.

entries.title: Germany news: Merz says Trump's Russia diesel deal 'out of question' for Europe
entries.snippet: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has said that Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia would be "out of the question" for Germany and the EU. Meanwhile, the ruling coalition has been rocked by a major resignation.

entries.title: US federal agents search home of Trump critic Ilhan Omar
entries.snippet: Justice Department officials said the Washington residence of Democratic Congresswoman Ilhan Omar, an outspoken opponent of President Trump, was raided as "part of an ongoing federal investigation."

entries.title: Pope lung nodule: Could it be cancer?
entries.snippet: The case of Pope Leo shows how small lung nodules are often found during routine health checks. Quick treatment is generally advised before nodules can grow to become larger life-threatening masses.

entries.title: Starlink India launch: Why Elon Musk is still waiting
entries.snippet: Despite securing key approvals, the Starlink satellite internet service remains in regulatory limbo, raising questions about security clearances, competition and India’s investment climate.

entries.title: Can South Korea and Ukraine resolve their diplomatic spat over North Korean POWs?
entries.snippet: Seoul and Kyiv are trading accusations after the transfer of two North Korean POWs to South Korea. The South insists the move was to be kept secret as it seeks to avoid antagonizing Pyongyang.

entries.title: Cyprus closer than ever to joining Schengen but political hurdles relating to the Green Line and British Sovereign Base Areas remain
entries.snippet: The European Commission says Cyprus is ready to join the Schengen Area. Yet questions relating to the island's division and British military bases could still complicate its path to Europe's border-free travel zone.

entries.title: Ukraine says Russia launched strikes hours after Donald Trump announced an 'energy ceasefire'
entries.snippet: Less than 24 hours after Donald Trump announced an "energy ceasefire," Ukraine reported Russian strikes in Kyiv, Kharkiv and Donetsk. The Kremlin says it would only consider a one-day ceasefire for an election.

entries.title: Germany's Wadephul calls new EU sanctions 'unprecedented' blow to Russia
entries.snippet: The European Union has approved its largest-ever sanctions package against Moscow, targeting more than 1,000 entities tied to the military-industrial complex. The move took place in an EU foreign ministers' meeting.

entries.title: Saudi Arabia: Deadly Houthi strikes on Riyadh airport fuel fears of wider Middle East conflict
entries.snippet: Riyadh airport will remain closed at least until the weekend amid deadly strikes by Yemen-based Houthis. The US has said it is weighing joining Saudi military operations. More on DW.

entries.title: Nobel Prize in Economics goes to pair of US economists
entries.snippet: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford got the Nobel for developing economic models that help governments and central banks respond more effectively to booms and recessions.

entries.title: India news: Opposition parties march to Supreme Court
entries.snippet: Intensifying their demand for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation, opposition parties are holding a march to the Supreme Court. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Germany's women: Ena Mahmutovic makes her case to become Germany's next No.1 goalkeeper
entries.snippet: Germany's win against Australia saw Ena Mahmutovic excel in goal. The 22-year-old Bayern Munich goalkeeper is considered the successor to Ann-Katrin Berger and is making a name for herself.

entries.title: Frankfurt Book Fair: Rights lawyer Sands awarded peace prize
entries.snippet: Franco-British lawyer and author Philippe Sands was awarded the German Book Trade's Peace Prize this weekend. Accepting the award, Sands criticized Germany's "inappropriate silence" regarding Israel.

entries.title: How green is Europe's urban public transport? A data-driven reality check
